fusions.name: Creeping Runners
fusions.desc: Sends runners of hair along the ground to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 12 nature damage and leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Pinning Tendril
fusions.desc: A tendril of hair drives into a target up to 6 tiles away for 7 nature damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Holds 3 charges; kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Greening Patch
fusions.desc: Roots your strands into the ground where you stand. For 10 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Sap Rise
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 6%. It also regenerates 0.8 health a second, permanently.
